vineyards.name: Aux Brûlées

vineyards.name: Clos des Corvées
vineyards.style_notes: Southern section — structured and mineral

vineyards.name: Les Perrières

vineyards.name: Champ Canet

vineyards.name: Les Referts
vineyards.style_notes: South of the village — charming, ready earlier

vineyards.name: Clos de la Garenne

vineyards.name: Bâtard-Montrachet (Chassagne portion)

vineyards.name: Les Caillerets

vineyards.name: Les Murgers des Dents de Chien

vineyards.name: La Chatenière
vineyards.style_notes: Reliable — generous, fruity whites

vineyards.name: Les Combes au Sud
vineyards.style_notes: Charming whites — good value

vineyards.style_notes: Structured and firm — good aging potential

vineyards.name: La Fussière
vineyards.style_notes: Largest Premier Cru — reliable, good value

vineyards.name: Clos Saint-Jacques
vineyards.style_notes: Best white — mineral, precise, ages well

vineyards.name: Les Cloux
vineyards.style_notes: Fine whites — generous and balanced

vineyards.name: La Pucelle
vineyards.style_notes: Charming whites — floral and fresh

vineyards.name: Grésigny
vineyards.style_notes: Good reds — firm structure

vineyards.name: Rabourcé
vineyards.style_notes: Red Premier Cru — earthy and structured

vineyards.name: Clos des Barraults

vineyards.name: Les Velley
vineyards.style_notes: Elegant and aromatic — lighter style for Mercurey

vineyards.name: Clos Voyens
vineyards.style_notes: Well-sited — firm, mineral reds

vineyards.name: Les Byots
vineyards.style_notes: Southern exposure — ripe and generous

vineyards.name: Les Croichots
vineyards.style_notes: Structured — good aging potential

vineyards.name: Clos du Roi
